description: This file provides documentation for the WebError class, describing its purpose, usage examples in multiple languages (Java, Python, C#), its methods, and related symbols. It serves as an API reference or documentation page rather than an actual source code implementation.

classes.name: WebError
classes.description: Represents an unhandled exception thrown in the page. It is dispatched via the BrowserContext.webError event and provides methods to access details about the error and the page.

methods.name: WebError.page
methods.description: Returns the page that produced this unhandled exception, if any.

methods.name: WebError.error
methods.description: Returns the unhandled error that was thrown. The returned value's type can be an Error object or a string, depending on the context.
